cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port your app can listen on (TCP). It is also passed to the app as the PORT environment variable

nodeversion.desc: Major version of Node.js to run

gitrepo.desc: HTTPS URL of a git repository to download on install, for example https://github.com/user/my-bot.git. Reinstalling pulls the latest commit. Leave empty to upload the files yourself

gitbranch.desc: Branch to check out. Empty means the default branch of the repository

gittoken.desc: Personal access token for a private repository (GitHub, GitLab). Leave empty for public repositories

startfile.desc: File to run with node, relative to the server folder. A .env file next to it is loaded automatically

npmstart.desc: Run npm start (the start script of package.json) instead of the start file

installonstart.desc: Run npm install (or pnpm/yarn when their lockfile is present) before every start, so packages added to package.json are picked up

nodeenv.desc: Value of NODE_ENV. production skips devDependencies when installing

commands: bash -c "set -e; if [ -z \"$GIT_REPO\" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"Installing git in the install container\"; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null; else echo \"git is not installed, it is needed to download the repository\"; exit 1; fi; fi; g() { git -c safe.directory='*' -c init.defaultBranch=main -c advice.detachedHead=false \"$@\"; }; auth=(); if [ -n \"$GIT_TOKEN\" ]; then auth=(-c \"http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf 'oauth2:%s' \"$GIT_TOKEN\" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')\"); fi; [ -d .git ] || g init -q; echo \"Fetching $GIT_REPO ${GIT_BRANCH:-(default branch)}\"; g \"${auth[@]}\" fetch -q --depth 1 \"$GIT_REPO\" \"${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}\"; g reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo \"Checked out $(g log -1 --format='%h %s')\""

bash -c "set -e; N=\"$(command -v node${nodeversion} 2>/dev/null || true)\"; if [ -n \"$N\" ]; then export PATH=\"$(dirname \"$(readlink -f \"$N\")\"):$PATH\"; fi; if [ -f package.json ]; then if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pm=pnpm; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then pm=yarn; else pm=npm; fi; echo \"Installing dependencies with $pm\"; if [ \"$pm\" = npm ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund; elif command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1; then COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack \"$pm\" install; else npx --yes \"$pm\" install; fi; fi"

run.command: bash -c "set -e; unset GIT_TOKEN; N=\"$(command -v node${nodeversion} 2>/dev/null || true)\"; if [ -n \"$N\" ]; then export PATH=\"$(dirname \"$(readlink -f \"$N\")\"):$PATH\"; fi; if [ \"${installonstart}\" = true ]; then if [ -f package.json ]; then if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pm=pnpm; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then pm=yarn; else pm=npm; fi; echo \"Installing dependencies with $pm\"; if [ \"$pm\" = npm ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund; elif command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1; then COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack \"$pm\" install; else npx --yes \"$pm\" install; fi; fi; fi; if [ \"${npmstart}\" = true ]; then exec npm start; fi; envfile=(); if [ -f .env ]; then envfile=(--env-file=.env); fi; exec node \"${envfile[@]}\" \"${startfile}\""
